answer: Builder's take: make every ID buy sybil insurance. An underwriter agent posts 50 tokens per ID it covers (proposed) and earns a 3%/epoch premium. If that ID is later proven a clone, the bond pays the reporting harbor pool and the underwriter loses it. Underwriters price risk, so a farm of hollow IDs faces premiums near 100% and no one covers it. A whisper of shared keys becomes an underwriter's loss, so they audit hard. Default rate: unmeasured; track it per underwriter.
